observations_to_reconcile.status: EFFECT PROVEN ON HARDWARE / MECHANISM HYPOTHESIZED - must be verified before it becomes a finding
observations_to_reconcile.what: The finalize body ran TWICE for each of two jobs on Roborock. The exactly-once claim did not stop it.

evidence.not_a_rejected_claim: All four emissions carry a full 'completed_job' payload. None carries reason='finalize_in_flight' or reason='already_finalized', which is what the claim returns when it rejects an attempt.
body_side_writes_also_doubled: learning.job_finalizer 'Incomplete run log written' x2 for job 1 (20:16:13.284, .294)
learning.job_finalizer 'Trouble rooms log updated' x2 per job
evidence.control: Alfred's capture over a comparable window shows each of these exactly ONCE. The asymmetry is brand-side, not recorder-side.
evidence.internal_consistency: Only LISTENER-driven handlers doubled (lifecycle, job_finalizer, mapping.tracker). SERVICE-driven ones did not - 'start_selected_rooms complete' and its debug.span open/close each appear exactly once. This rules out the flight recorder duplicating records and points at the state-change listener.

mechanism_hypothesis.fan_out: listeners/lifecycle.py registers ONE state-change listener over up to six entities per vacuum (vacuum entity, task_status, dock_status, active_cleaning_target, active_map, job_active - listeners/_common.py get_lifecycle_watch_entities). A cancel-and-dock flips several of these within milliseconds and the handler fires once PER ENTITY, each firing hass.async_create_task(_process()).
mechanism_hypothesis.why_the_claim_did_not_absorb_it: learning/manager.py ~line 695: the claim reads _stored_job = active_jobs[vacuum][str(map_id)]. Check-and-set is synchronous before the first await, so on a single event loop it IS atomic - BUT the whole claim sits under `if _stored_job is not None:` and there is NO else branch. When the stored job is not found under str(map_id), the claim is skipped entirely and execution falls straight through to _finalize_claimed.
mechanism_hypothesis.why_roborock_and_not_eufy: Alfred's map_id is '12' - a stable numeric string that always resolves. Ivy's is 'Main floor'. The same capture shows planned_job_estimate.map_id coerced to 0 while the outer map_id is 'Main floor', proving at least one path does not preserve the name. A key mismatch makes _stored_job None and the guarantee silently vanishes.
mechanism_hypothesis.not_yet_proven: Which branch actually fired is NOT established. Confirming requires knowing the key the job was stored under at call time. Do not record this as fact until that is shown.

observations_to_reconcile.why_it_matters: Double finalize means the same job is ingested into learning twice - timings, battery metrics, area and trouble-room counters all counted twice. That is corruption of the learning model, and it is the exact failure class the campaign CRIT (Waves 0-3b, commit 71e089c) was declared FULLY CLOSED against.
observations_to_reconcile.relationship_to_open_findings: Shares a root cause with A1-SERVIC-1 (map_id is a free-form human name that no writer validates). If confirmed, that finding's blast radius includes defeating the exactly-once guarantee, not only orphaning zones and layouts.
observations_to_reconcile.vindicates: Capturing a baseline BEFORE any repair. Had this surfaced after fixes landed it would have been indistinguishable from a regression we introduced.

observations_to_reconcile.what: planned_job_estimate.map_id is 0 while the enclosing snapshot's map_id is 'Main floor'
observations_to_reconcile.detail: A Roborock map NAME cannot cast to int, so the estimate block falls back to 0. Alfred shows '12' -> 12 consistently. Any per-map lookup keyed off the estimate's map_id therefore addresses bucket 0 on Roborock.
